name: shift a register, feeding back the XOR of tapped bits
mechanism: each step shifts every bit one place, outputs the bit that falls off, and fills the vacated place with the XOR of a fixed set of tap positions; with taps from a primitive polynomial the sequence runs through every nonzero state before repeating

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Linear-feedback shift register (note' in section Computer science / Cryptography: many LFSR-based algorithms are weak or have been broken)

fails_when: linear: a short run of output reveals the taps and the state
